{%- comment -%}
================================================================================
llms.txt — GENERATED. Do not edit the facts below; edit _data/pact.yml.

HONEST STATUS: THIS IS A CHEAP OPTION ON A MAYBE, NOT A PROVEN CHANNEL.
No major model provider documents reading llms.txt in production. Google's
Search team has said publicly that it does not use it. The largest measurement
available (Ahrefs, ~137,000 sites) found that 97% of llms.txt files received no
traffic at all, and that AI bots never requested the file on domains that
lacked one. Occasional crawler fetches are not evidence that the file changed an
answer. Nobody should point at this file and claim a discovery win.

WHY IT IS SHIPPED ANYWAY. The only serious argument against it was drift: a
second, hand-maintained copy of Pact's facts sitting beside the HTML with
nothing keeping the two in step — which is precisely the failure mode this
project is otherwise built to refuse. That argument is answered here by
construction. Every fact below is read at build time from _data/ — the same
files that generate the JSON-LD in _includes/head-custom.html. Product facts
come from _data/pact.yml; the questions come from _data/faq.yml, which
tools/build-faq-data.rb derives from pact-faq.md, so they are literally the
visible page text. There is one copy of each fact. Editing the app's
capabilities in one place updates every surface, so the marginal cost of this
file is genuinely zero and it cannot become wrong on its own.

IF THE CONVENTION IS ABANDONED, delete this file. Nothing else depends on it.
The real work is in the HTML: page descriptions, the JSON-LD in
head-custom.html, and the answers on /pact/faq/ and /pact/support/.
================================================================================
{%- endcomment -%}

## Get it

- [{{ pact.full_name }} on the App Store]({{ pact.app_store_url }}): the only place to download Pact. Apple ID {{ pact.app_store_id }}.

## Pages

- [About Pact]({{ pact.page_url }}): what Pact does, how the loop works, and what it costs in structure.
- [Pact FAQ]({{ site.url }}{{ site.data.faq.page_url }}): short, self-contained answers on invoicing brand deals, getting paid, and what Pact does and does not do.
- [How to invoice a brand deal]({{ site.url }}/pact/how-to-invoice-a-brand-deal/): a practical guide — what goes on the invoice, what an accounts-payable team needs before it can pay, how net terms work, and what to do when a payment is late. Written for creators generally, not only for Pact users.
- [Pact Support]({{ site.url }}/pact/support/): the longer answers — GST registration, place of supply, TDS, tax outside India, bank identifiers, backups, exports, why a field is amber, why a reminder did not arrive.
- [Pact Privacy Policy]({{ site.url }}/pact/privacy/): written against India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, with the equivalent rights stated for users under the EU/UK GDPR and the CCPA. Pact makes no network requests of its own and there is no server to receive anything.
- [Pact Terms of Use]({{ site.url }}/pact/terms/): subscription billing, cancellation, the limits of what the app does, and that Pact is a tool — not tax, legal, or accounting advice.
